intro x
let S := LieSubalgebra.engel K x
have hS : LieSubalgebra K S := by apply LieSubalgebra.mk
let L' := ↥(LieSubalgebra.engel K x)
let L'_k : K-module L' := by apply Module.restrictScalars
let L'_k' : K-module L' := by apply Module.restrictScalars
have hL'_k : Module.Finite K L' := by apply Module.Finite.restrictScalars
let f := LinearMap.charpoly (LieAlgebra.ad K L x)
let f_natTrailingDegree := f.natTrailingDegree
have h_f : f = LinearMap.charpoly (LieAlgebra.ad K L x) := rfl
let f_deg := f.natTrailingDegree
let deg_LieSubalgebra := Module.finrank K L'
let deg_charpoly := f_deg
have h_deg_eq : deg_LieSubalgebra = deg_charpoly :=
  by
    apply eq_of_submodule_rank_eq_charpoly_degree
    exact hS
    exact hL'_k
    exact h_f
    exact h_deg_eq
